acceptanceCriteria: A >= 100k-record fixture answers every listed tool.
A corpus that exceeds a documented bound is refused once, in under 50 ms, naming the bound and the observed size, not recomputed per call or per batch path.
`docs corpus build` reports the bound at build time instead of producing an artifact most tools cannot read.
body: On a corpus of 8,251 pinned inputs (~100k records, 78 MB artifact; build main-29c7eeb), nine indexed corpus MCP tools (docs_concept, docs_flow, docs_claims, docs_dependencies, docs_recommend_tests, docs_gaps, docs_intent, docs_navigation, docs_vocabulary) return `corpus-refused: indexed postings or key byte bound exceeded` (bound 1,000,000 postings / 16 MiB keys) on every call. The refusal is recomputed per call and per batch path (20 paths took 11.9 s).
title: GH #1254: indexed corpus tools refuse every call once a corpus exceeds the postings/key bound
